item.title: Three-day state mourning declared for Khaleda Zia
item.description: Dhaka – The government has announced a three-day state mourning to honor former prime minister Khaleda Zia. Khaleda Zia, the chief of Bangladesh Nationalist Party and the country’s first female prime minister, passed away at the age of 80 in a Dhaka hospital on Tuesday. Chief of the Interim Administration, Mohammad Yunus, made the announcement […]

item.title: “To me, Khaleda Zia was loving mother,” says Tarique Rahman
item.description: Dhaka – In an emotionally charged Facebook post, Tarique Rahman, the eldest son of former prime minister Khaleda Zia, said that his mother had sacrificed her entire life for the nation. “To me, Khaleda Zia was a tender and loving mother who devoted her entire life to the country and its people,” said Rahman, referring to […]

item.title: With love and respect, a sea of mourners bids farewell to Khaleda Zia
item.description: Dhaka – Hundreds of thousands of people bid farewell to Bangladesh’s former prime minister Khaleda Zia on Wednesday with tears, love, and respect at a state funeral held at the National Parliament’s south plaza. item.title: Hasina sentenced to 10 more years in jail in graft cases
item.description: Dhaka – A court on Monday sentenced former prime minister Sheikh Hasina to 10 more years in prison in two corruption cases involving the allocation of government land plots to her nephew and niece. item.title: Bangladesh Police launch dedicated helpline numbers ahead of election
item.description: Dhaka – Bangladeshi police have announced dedicated mobile phone numbers for their operations control room to address law-and-order complaints ahead of the 13th national election, scheduled for February 12. item.title: Biman gets first female CEO
item.description: Dhaka – Biman Bangladesh Airlines has appointed its first female chief executive, Dr. Humayra Sultana, a day after her predecessor was jailed alongside his wife in a criminal case involving the alleged torture of a minor domestic worker. item.title: Postal votes flood in for Bangladesh election
item.description: Dhaka – Bangladesh’s election authorities have received some 379,924 postal ballots from expatriate voters for the upcoming parliamentary election and a concurrent national referendum, an official said on Thursday. item.title: Chittagong Port operations shut as workers protest foreign lease deal
item.description: Dhaka – Operations at the Chittagong Port, main maritime gateway for Bangladesh’s trade, are practically shut down due to an indefinite work stoppage. Port workers are protesting the government’s decision to lease the facility to a foreign company.
